Stress the whole day

Runs this day about 22 times with your current settings and random faults off, so the only difference between runs is the change being tested. Takes a few seconds.

Staffing sweep

Runs this day at every mix of pick-module pickers and top-off staff below, to find the fewest people that hit the target and where adding people stops helping.

What to change

Tests each change on this day with your current settings and random faults off, then builds the plan that gets closest to the target. Apply any change, or the whole plan, and the live run restarts with it. Takes about a minute on big days.

Layer families

This day, by layer logic

Planned share of this day's cases by where they come from. Engine layers are whole layers the ASRS releases to the layer former. Top-off is what the palletizer can't build into a full layer. The four columns add to 100%.

Layer former, this run

What each wider tier buys

Planned shares for 9/25, 9/28 and 9/29 at each tier setting, with your other settings. Tiers 2 and 3 only merge groups with measured or standardized dims, so they match Tier 1 until dims are loaded.

Review groups

Check member SKUs and split them out, check two groups and merge them, or lock a group out of layering. Changes restart the run and last for this session.
